best_hook.why: A rich man snarling a theft accusation at the heroine's husband sets conflict and stakes in one line.

best_cliffhanger.why: The planted watch has just been pulled from the husband's coat and the villain gloats; arrest and the couple's fate hang unresolved.

must_promos.why: Opens on Juliana accusing her ex of a frame-up, builds through his baiting and Alexander's restraint, and cuts the instant the watch turns up in the coat with Gerald laughing.
The theft accusation, the 'you married a beggar' insult and the constable's demand all land fast, ending on Alexander's grim 'Search it.' before anyone knows what will be found.

standalone_risk: A stranger may not know Gerald is Juliana's former suitor or realise the watch was planted (it is implied, never shown), so the find could read as Alexander actually being a thief.
notes: The strongest material (accusation and watch reveal) sits about 77 s apart, too far for one continuous 60 s cut; a two-segment promo joining S01-B016 with the S02 watch reveal would be ideal.
